method: Multi-task source-fact supervision inspired by Distilling Step-by-Step; QLoRA with a matched-update label-only ablation. Not gradient-free weight-space programming.
selection: Select using old development only: complete valid replies, no new unsupported claims and no per-task outcome regression relative to base. Rank by false claims, full outcomes, misses. Freeze final-step label-only or source-facts adapter before new test. A failed candidate is not a live upgrade.

live.mode: Owner-authorized reversible local trial only after paired quality, actual runtime and host checks. Preserve base/tag/preferences for rollback. Independent labels and broad agency validity remain unproven.

privacy: Invented fixtures only, no personal conversation training, no remote inference/upload, no foreground UI testing. Use reduced-priority background jobs serially.
